Requests sent to LuxAI by other programs always need your approval. Only with the Flash model; Lite always asks for the password. Destructive commands (deleting the system or home folder, formatting disks, removing the bootloader, changing accounts, sudo or polkit) are always refused. Every command is logged in ~/.local/state/luxai/root-commands.log.
